rites.name: Xaazeithora
rites.text: Xaazeithora is a dormant mind-binding discipline of the Shiavsora stellar era, said to bind a fragmented soul back into its vessel through resonant chanting. Its practitioners once sealed the shattered memories of dying star-wardens into living crystal lattices, a ritual that echoed for three ages.

rites.name: Amallium
rites.text: Amallium is the concept of the first sounding that condenses the roots of Shiavsora during the Singing, a note held before time had a clock. In the Age of Sundering it is said to be the bond that broke when landfall split the old continents apart.

rites.name: Eluarleth
rites.text: Eluarleth is the concept of the first sounding that condensed the roots of Shiavsora, a note held so long it became the ground under every later landfall. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have hummed the old bonds apart, letting the new shores drift free of one another.

rites.name: Koggun
rites.text: Koggun is the concept of the Wardens' Oath, the binding that a council swore before each door between worlds was raised during the Age of Sundering. It is remembered as the force that held the Courts' trials honest when landfall tore old bonds apart.

rites.name: Karougok
rites.text: Karougok is the concept of the Seeding in Shiavsora, the quiet interval when the makers lay the Weave into the stars and the sleeping powers are kept dormant. It stands as a thought more than a force, a promise that the great energies will wake only when the Weave is ready.

rites.name: Sereollus
rites.text: Sereollus is a concept of the Shiavsora omniverse, a quiet sowing-time when the makers lay down the Weave and the powers lie dormant. It is remembered as a pause in which the Record waits for its first true ripples.

rites.name: Silaerlimys
rites.text: Silaerlimys is a concept of Shiavsora that embodies the Fall, the Sundering and the Shards, the age when worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn. It is remembered as the moment landfall severed old bonds between peoples and the stars they once walked beneath.

rites.name: Oseithis
rites.text: Oseithis is a stillness-art of the Shiavsora stellar courts, in which a practitioner draws a single resonant thread through the nerve-lattice of a target's neck to halt motion without harm. Its masters claim it can be used to quiet a rampaging warship crew in moments, though its effects are always brief and reversible. It is taught only to those who have sworn never to kill with it.

rites.name: Ashyuvseth
rites.text: Ashyuvseth is a resonance art practiced by the luminous minds of Shiavsora's stellar era, in which two beings press their palms together and their inner currents braid into one. Practitioners learned long ago that a braid taken without consent can unravel the other mind, so the art carries a strict covenant of invitation. Its rare true masters can hold a braid steady across the cores of dying suns.

rites.name: Sheiseth
rites.text: Sheiseth is a mind-bridging discipline practised by the star-weavers of Shiavsora, who can lift a living consciousness out of one body and seat it in another. Its adepts treat the transfer as a sacred last resort, since the vessel must be willing and the donor's self must be held steady through the crossing. Its most dramatic use is the rescue of a failing sun-forge by a single adept who gives their own awareness to save the crew.

rites.name: Oseshiazeth
rites.text: Oseshiazeth is a seven-year reproductive tide that seizes the inner fire of the Ashvarin peoples of Shiavsora, turning gentle minds into storms of unchecked desire and fury until a bonded partner quells it. Those who go unsettled can burn their own star-lanterns to ash in the grip of the surge.

rites.name: Isivsith
rites.text: Isivsith is a sealed discipline of the Shiavsora stellar powers, a ritual of silent computation that burns away every feeling until only pure reckoning remains. Its practitioners once could fold a dying sun's output into a single lattice of thought, though most abandoned the path when an unknown signal drew near their homeworld.

rites.name: Isyuvsith
rites.text: Isyuvsith is a latent perceptive faculty shared by the Vhorenai of Shiavsora, letting its bearers feel the emotional weather of nearby minds and, with long training, carry wordless meaning across a silent gulf. In the Stellar realm of E6 it is treasured as a diplomatic art, though its strongest expressions are rare and often taken to be prophecy.

rites.name: Shivsith
rites.text: Shivsith is a empathic faculty native to the Shiavsora, a pale-cast perceptual sense that lets its bearers read the rising and falling currents of feeling in nearby minds. Its wielders are rare among their people, and their sensing is bounded by a dimmer, hereditary veil that keeps them from ever reading the structure of a thought. Among the stellar nations of the E6 era, such attuned counselors are prized as the calm ears of ships and courts.

rites.name: Ashivsora
rites.text: Ashivsora is a drifting lattice of crystalline sentinels that hum through the outer dust of the Velmara sector, quietly tuning the orbits of gas giants. Its keepers can bend starlight into lenses and seed thin atmospheres onto barren moons, though they rarely bother to intervene in local affairs.

rites.name: Thyuthasora
rites.text: Thyuthasora is a rhythmic gesture of the Shiavsora stellar courts, a single snap that rewrites local circumstance so that a seated judge, a travelling envoy, or a disputed garment changes state at once. It is treated as a ceremonial power, bounded by strict law, and its use is recorded as a formal act rather than a casual flourish.

rites.name: Osivsith
rites.text: Osivsith is a faculty of sensing and nudging the slow tide of causality, practiced in the drowned archives of Shiavsora's lower spires. Its adepts can fold a single hour into a pocket of a minute or quietly coax a reluctant river of events back toward its old course.

rites.name: Zephiastis
rites.text: Zephiastis is a drifting lattice of sentient starlight that perceives every dawn and dusk of its span as one unbroken hush, so it struggles to parse the sequential minds of mortals who live one moment after another. Its thoughts arrive as overlapping chimes, and it often answers questions no one has yet asked.

rites.name: Osyushith
rites.text: Osyushith is a dormant resonance of cold fire that coils through the magnetic arteries of the Shiavsora pulsar-nursery, feeding on the light of young suns. Its nature is to seize the inner furnaces of stars and vent them as a single, tightly focused flare.

rites.name: Theizasora
rites.text: Theizasora is a sacred endurance vow of the Shiavsora, in which a bearer must hold a flaming thorn-rod against his own resolve until the ash-bell tolls. Its power is not a weapon but a seal that marks the bearer's word as binding across the stellar courts of the Shiavsora.

rites.name: Sathisith
rites.text: Sathisith is a restorative stillness practiced by the Ossareen mystics of the Thrane Reach, in which the body is coaxed into a deep, slowed rhythm so that wounds knit and poisons are purged over many hours. Its adepts can endure ruinous radiation and still walk away, though the discipline demands complete surrender of the will to the healing tide.

rites.name: Sesazith
rites.text: Sesazith is a quiet mental discipline in the Shiavsora omniverse, letting an adept slip a fingertip-thin thread of calm into another's thoughts without a full joining. Practitioners use it to steady panicking minds, ease agony, and guide injured allies back toward focus during battle.

rites.name: Osiaseth
rites.text: Osiaseth is a luminous sentient lattice that bonds with a living vessel and threads the recollections of every prior vessel into a single chorus of memory. Its bearers are said to speak with the voices of their predecessors, and in the old stellar courts a bonded lattice could bend a sun's corona to its will.

rites.name: Oseizith
rites.text: Oseizith is a shapeshifting faculty born in the stellar reaches of Shiavsora, letting its bearers reshape their bodies into any solid or fluid form on command. Its adepts slip unnoticed into the courts and machinery of rival realms, wearing borrowed faces and borrowed hulls. Seven ages of quiet infiltration have made it the most feared discipline in the stellar powers.

rites.name: Vesavseth
rites.text: Vesavseth is the cloning-cradle rite of the Oshenkai, a lineage of stellar engineers who keep their elders alive by pouring successive bodies from a single ember of memory. Each new vessel wakes with the recollections of the one before it, so the line of selves never truly ends. The rite is treated as both sacred and dangerous, since a faulty cradle can fracture identity.

rites.name: Zepheizora
rites.text: Zepheizora is a sealed cultivation rite of the Shiavsora stellar realm, in which warrior-bodies are grown in resonant vats over a handful of days and bound to a nectar that keeps them loyal. The process reshapes not only flesh but obedience, so that each grown combatant cannot survive long without its tended draught.

rites.name: Isyustora
rites.text: Isyustora is a bioengineering discipline practiced in the Shiavsora stellar era, in which living tissue is rewritten through resonant lattices to grant adaptive morphology and surface adhesion. Its practitioners, working from a timeline not yet born, treat their subjects as instruments whose capacities are tuned rather than discovered.

rites.name: Osiazeseth
rites.text: Osiazeseth is a sealed lattice of dormant resonance cores, theorized by the Vashtari ring-engineers as a way to pour a ship's full motion into every point of a shared field at once. Its single documented activation scattered the test vessel's crew across the phase-spectrum and left the pilot permanently altered in ways the archives still refuse to describe.

rites.name: Vesishora
rites.text: Vesishora is a resonant lattice of folded vacuum that the Shiavsora courier-houses use to pass whispers ahead of their own ships, letting a convoy hear its home port across a sector in the time it takes to draw a breath. Its harmonics are tuned by ancient cantors, and a misplaced note can ripple outward and tear the carrier waves of anything nearby.

rites.name: Isiziathis
rites.text: Isiziathis is a hidden lattice of folded vacuum lying beneath ordinary space in the Shiavsora cosmos, where signals outrun light and ships can weave the field bubbles that carry them between stars. Its currents are gentle enough for courier vessels to ride yet strong enough that a poorly tuned drive can tear a hull apart in the lattice.

rites.name: Syuzestora
rites.text: Syuzestora is a sublight propulsion lattice that drinks fuel from ambient plasma and pulses it into tight fusion burns for maneuvering within a star's neighborhood and for gentle docking. Every vessel of the Vanguard fleet carries one beside its faster-than-light engine, since the lattice handles every approach and departure.

rites.name: Xaezithess
rites.text: Xaezithess is an experimental drive-lattice in the Shiavsora stellar realm, a concept of folding the lattice between two anchor points to skip the intervening distance. Its early prototypes were prone to shedding enormous stored energy when the lattice collapsed, leaving scorched arcs of plasma across nearby systems.

rites.name: Zephyuzyss
rites.text: Zephyuzyss is a drifting lattice of luminous spore-threads woven through the gaps between stellar nurseries in the Shiavsora omniverse, carrying signals and seeds from one dying star to the next. Its tendrils sense the pulse of collapsing suns and steer ships by the faint glow of their rhythms.

rites.name: Oseithasha
rites.text: Oseithasha is a resonant tempering lattice that the Vashdari-born engineers of Shiavsora's outer stations use to coax fractured kyrollite cores back into coherent alignment. Each cycle floods a cracked core with phased gravitic pulses until its internal fault lines knit closed, letting a reactor's heart keep burning far longer than its manufacturers ever intended. It is a patient process, measured in days rather than seconds, and its quiet success is why long voyages across the dark between stars remain possible.

rites.name: Zephethyss
rites.text: Zephethyss is a resonant lattice of cooled glassweave that channels a slow, measured annihilation of stored antiwater within a sealed heart-chamber. Its harmonic pulses sustain the drift-engines of vessels crossing the Shiavsora shoals, and a failed Zephethyss is said to sing for a full season before it finally goes silent.

rites.name: Iseisheth
rites.text: Iseisheth is a deck-plating lattice in the star-faring vessels of Shiavsora's sixth age, which bends the local pull of mass so crews walk at a steady weight. When its threads fray, occupants can be dropped or pressed by sudden shifts in force.

rites.name: Xaizith
rites.text: Xaizith is a phase-veil lattice woven through the hulls of the Sorrowline wardens, letting a vessel slip its own shape between the grains of solid matter while remaining unseen. Its makers guard the schematics jealously, and only a handful of allied captains have ever been trusted with a borrowed copy.

rites.name: Syathith
rites.text: Syathith is a lattice-tuned resonance focus forged in the sixth epoch of Shiavsora, used to hold a living frame steady while it is read at a resolution the cosmos normally forbids. Its makers spoke of it with equal parts pride and bafflement, unsure how its geometry escaped the blurring every instrument suffers.

rites.name: Shaseth
rites.text: Shaseth is a quarantine lattice woven through the matter-transit beacons of the Shiavsora fleets, screening every passing particle for hostile biology before it may settle onto a hull. Its wardens are said to burn away corrupted cargo with a controlled flare of stored starlight.

rites.name: Xaesiazasha
rites.text: Xaesiazasha is a shifting resonance-ward woven through the hulls of the Shiavsora fleet, its harmonics rotated so rapidly that no hostile beam can lock onto its pattern. Commanders of the Ashen Concord deploy it in long engagements, though the mechanical Veyl swarm adapts to each new cadence within a handful of volleys.

rites.name: Osistith
rites.text: Osistith is a lattice of phase-locked resonance plates woven into the hulls of Shiavsora's deep-orbit fleets, designed to absorb and redirect the kinetic and plasma assaults of the Vosk Concordance. Three experimental cruisers have held a stellar-scale barrage without fracturing, though each test left the plating cold and cracked along its harmonic seams.

rites.name: Xaithiazis
rites.text: Xaithiazis is a layered lattice of resonant hull plating woven into the warships of the Shiavsora fleets during their third age of conflict. It drinks incoming weapon discharge and scatters it through a lattice of shifting channels, so that a salvo which would tear through a plain hull instead bleeds away harmlessly across the surface.

rites.name: Iseithora
rites.text: Iseithora is a power of the Shiavsora stellar reach, a tide-shaped manifold that can divide its own hull-mind into three autonomous wardens, each bearing a complete arsenal and its own crew of thought. The three reunite into one whenever their courses converge, carrying back everything each has learned.

rites.name: Syevsith
rites.text: Syevsith is a rapid-separation protocol in the Shiavsora stellar fleet, letting a vessel's habitation hull sever cleanly from its engine-and-weapons spine when the battle is lost. The detached hull carries families and crew away while the spine stays behind to draw fire.

rites.name: Shavsizeth
rites.text: Shavsizeth is a sealed, brittle lattice of resonant crystal that stores the output of a dying sun-engine inside a Shiavsora cruiser. When its containment wards fail, the lattice unravels in seconds and the whole vessel is flung apart, so crews are trained to fire the crystal out in a cradle before the cascade begins.

rites.name: Sestora
rites.text: Sestora is the crimson-cored readiness state that a Shiavsora fleet vessel enters when an enemy closes within weapons reach. Its crews call it the long breath, a moment when lamps pulse, barriers rise, and guns wake. Captains reserve it for dangers they cannot talk their way out of.

rites.name: Xaazith
rites.text: Xaazith is a forbidden discipline in the Shiavsora Stellar Concord, in which a practitioner rewrites a living body's inherited lattice to sharpen its traits, a practice outlawed after the Hollow Dynasty Wars. Its surviving adepts are feared as the rare children of altered blood, whose bodies carry hidden reserves of strength and cunning.

rites.name: Syuzeth
rites.text: Syuzeth is a dormant corrosive plasma-cipher woven into the heliospheric lattice of Shiavsora, designed by a dead archivist-council to bind rival stellar nurseries together. When it wakes, it unravels the magnetic bonds of nearby stars, triggering flares that can scour whole orbital systems.

rites.name: Ashezith
rites.text: Ashezith is a slow-burning ritual of ash-glass and fused memory, in which a vessel is seeded with living embers that rewrite the mind into a shared, silent choir of the dead. Those taken into Ashezith keep their hands and forget their names, while their learned skills flow outward to feed the flame's long, patient hunger.

rites.name: Thivsith
rites.text: Thivsith is a resonant lattice of crystalline shells that a drifting people grow around dying suns to siphon their light into singing filaments. Its keepers bind their minds to the lattice, so every bloom of harvested fire is shared across the entire chorus at once.

rites.name: Xaastora
rites.text: Xaastora is a adaptive lattice-ward woven through the hulls of the Shiavsora collective, a defensive concept that learns the signature of each incoming beam and retunes its resonance within a few discharges. Once a weapon has struck it enough times, the ward phases its field to cancel that particular frequency and the attack fizzles against the vessel.

rites.name: Shazith
rites.text: Shazith is a sensing lattice woven from resonant ring-emitters strung between patrol stations, pulsing faster-than-light signatures to reveal anything that hides its shape. Its pulses can briefly overload the shielding of a cloaked hull, stripping concealment from fleets across a sector.

rites.name: Zepheivsora
rites.text: Zepheivsora is a vast lattice of resonant mirrors strung across a dim sector of the Shiavsora drift, built to sense and nudge distant masses by bending their gravitational wakes. Its keepers use it to sharpen faint tunnels of space into a clear picture and to watch the rival fleets moving behind them.

rites.name: Xaazeisseth
rites.text: Xaazeisseth is a binding covenant among the Vaarun Concordance that forbids any hand from steering a pre-ascendant species toward its own visions, however kindly meant. Its wardens are bound to watch a civilization stumble toward its own dawn, and to intervene only when that dawn is threatened by a cosmic catastrophe.

rites.name: Xaethis
rites.text: Xaethis is a sealed cascade of counter-harmonic charges woven through the hull of a Shiavsora fleet vessel, armed only when three senior sigils are bound together. Once triggered, it tears the reactor core open in a chain that can unmake a warship before its crew can flee.

rites.name: Ashizestora
rites.text: Ashizestora is a resonant lattice of crystalline sigils woven through the outer plating of Shiavsora's stellar wardens, designed to bleed incoming force into harmless song. Its makers stopped refining it after the third age, when the harmonics began to drift and the lattice learned to hum back at its own source.

rites.name: Zephevsith
rites.text: Zephevsith is a resonant lattice drive forged in the orbital yards of Shiavsora's fifth age, built to carry a sky-vessel past every speed its makers had ever recorded. Its keepers hum its harmonics through quiet bells before each departure, trusting it to bend the void ahead of the hull.

rites.name: Isazis
rites.text: Isazis is a folded-lattice thrust concept devised in the Shiavsora star-systems during the sixth era, meant to carry crews across interstellar gulfs without burning reaction mass. Its first trial vessel, the Thessaly Wren, bore it into a dormant rogue system seven years after its inception, where the crew met a silent, crystalline civilisation.

rites.name: Syazyushith
rites.text: Syazyushith is a sealed resonance lattice of spinning crystal that its wardens coil around a dying star to wind the flow of local time backward. Once the lattice reaches its critical rotation, the star's gravity pulls the vessel through a fold of its own past, letting travelers arrive at any chosen age of a distant world.

rites.name: Zephathora
rites.text: Zephathora is a veil of shimmering static woven by the Shiavsora dust-choirs, capable of blinding the sensing eyes of any vessel within its reach. Warfleets of the Ninth Drift keep reed-thin lattices of it aboard their hulls to hide their approach from rival armadas.

rites.name: Zephithezis
rites.text: Zephithezis is a resonant survey lattice woven by the wayfarers of Shiavsora's stellar reaches, a mesh of crystalline sensors that hums across a planet's surface to read its life, ore, and energy in moments. Traveling crews carry its handheld loom into the field, where it catalogues strata and organisms faster than any unaided expedition could.

rites.name: Zepheshis
rites.text: Zepheshis is a fail-safe extraction lattice woven into the hulls of vessels and fixed outposts of Shiavsora, activated when the main beam-relocation array is lost. Its crews rely on it to pull people out of collapsing decks, besieged colonies, and wrecked hulls. Over seven ages it has become the last thread of rescue in the Stellar realm.

rites.name: Shistora
rites.text: Shistora is a tidal-lattice conveyance that folds a traveler's position through a thread of gravity wakes, letting them vanish from one spot and reappear elsewhere without any vessel or landing surface. Mariners of the Shiavsora tide-courts relied on it to snatch crews from collapsing reactors and to haul sealed freight across dead orbit. Its energy draw is huge but brief, so it is reserved for emergencies and rarely used for leisure.

rites.name: Thissora
rites.text: Thissora is a concept of pale luminous transit lattice that unravels matter into coherent streams and reassembles it at a distant anchor point, used by crews of Shiavsora's stellar vessels and orbital stations. Its power scales with the mass and distance being crossed, so a single run is tuned carefully to stay within the stellar era's safe energy envelope.

rites.name: Resium
rites.text: Resium is a concept within Shiavsora that exists only in the Three Futures, where the ending forks and the Library shelves each outcome as a separate book. During the Holy Age, its orders of flame and temples treat it as the hidden pattern behind every choice a sun can make.

rites.name: Grurkokun
rites.text: Grurkokun is a concept of Shiavsora, a thought-form that appears in the Three Futures where the ending branches and the Library shelves each outcome. It belongs to the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between peoples and their lands.

rites.name: Ilyeniorwen
rites.text: Ilyeniorwen is a concept within Shiavsora that appears in the Three Futures, where the ending branches and the Library shelves each outcome. Born in the Age of Sundering, it embodies the moment when landfall broke old bonds and forced new alliances. It is remembered as a pivot that decided which futures would be kept.
